name: peer-review
description: Independent, cross-vendor code review of the current diff via OpenAI's codex CLI -- deliberately never Claude reviewing its own diff, since that shares Claude's own blind spots.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-vendor peer review of the current diff.
interface.longDescription: Peer Review asks which supported provider should review the current diff, discovers available models when possible, and returns severity-ranked findings. Reviews run through the provider's installed CLI and are sent to that provider's cloud.
defaultPrompt: Review the current diff with an independent provider.
Get a second opinion on this code change.
